name: ICOSAPENT ETHYL
indications_original:
Icosapent ethyl capsules are indicated:
                  
                     as an adjunct to diet to reduce triglyceride (TG) levels in adult patients with severe (≥ 500 mg/dL) hypertriglyceridemia.
                  
                  
                     Limitations of Use:
                  
                  The effect of icosapent ethyl capsules on the risk for pancreatitis in patients with severe hypertriglyceridemia has not been determined.
contraindications_original: Assess lipid levels before initiating therapy. Identify other causes of high triglyceride levels and manage as appropriate. (2.1) Patients should engage in appropriate nutritional intake and physical activity before receiving icosapent ethyl capsules, which should continue during treatment. (2.1) The daily dose of icosapent ethyl capsules are 4 grams per day taken as either four 0.5 gram capsules twice daily with food or two 1 gram capsules twice daily with food. (2.2) Advise patients to swallow capsules whole. Do not break open, crush, dissolve, or chew icosapent ethyl capsules. (2.2)
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Icosapent ethyl capsules are supplied as:
                  The 0.5 gram icosapent ethyl capsule is available as a clear, transparent oval capsules containing a clear to light yellow colored solution imprinted with ‘547’.Bottles of 240 capsules NDC 72865-289-24
                  The 1 gram icosapent ethyl capsule is available as a clear, transparent oblong capsules containing a clear to light yellow colored solution imprinted with ‘291’.Bottles of 120 capsules NDC 72865-290-12
                  Store at 20° to 25° C (68° to 77°F); excursions permitted to 15° to 30° C (59° to 86°F) [see USP Controlled Room Temperature]. Keep out of reach of children.
adverseReactions_original: Icosapent ethyl capsules are contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity (e.g., anaphylactic reaction) to icosapent ethyl or any of its components.
